faqs.question: What does a performance marketing agency in India actually do?
faqs.answer: Performance marketing means every rupee you spend on ads should lead to something measurable, like a sale, a lead, or a booked call. We run campaigns on Meta Ads and Google Ads, test different creatives, and build a clear path from the first click to the final purchase.

faqs.question: Which platforms do you run performance marketing campaigns on?
faqs.answer: We run performance marketing campaigns mainly on Meta Ads and Google Ads. Before spending anything, we study your market, your competitors, and your audience, so budget goes to the platform where your buyers actually are and where results can be measured, not wherever is simply popular.

faqs.question: Which marketing performance metrics do you track?
faqs.answer: We track ROAS, CAC, and cost per result closely, so nothing runs on guesswork. Reporting stays honest and simple. You see what you spent, what it produced, and what we plan to test or scale next, based on real numbers instead of impressions or vanity views.

faqs.question: What is the difference between brand and performance marketing?
faqs.answer: Brand marketing builds awareness slowly over time, while performance based marketing is built to get direct, trackable results. We focus on the second, because many brands come to us when they need actual revenue, not just visibility. Both work best when they support each other.

faqs.question: Do you work as an ecommerce performance marketing agency for D2C brands?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work with D2C and ecommerce brands across India and internationally. We set campaigns live, test different creatives and offers, and only scale up spend once the numbers support it. Our team is based in Jaipur and works with clients remotely and in person.

faqs.question: How does performance marketing connect with your other services?
faqs.answer: Paid ads never run separately from the rest of your brand. Performance marketing connects with our SEO, conversion rate optimization, web development, and social media marketing work, so paid growth and organic growth support each other instead of pulling in different directions.

faqs.question: Do you use AI in social media marketing?

faqs.question: Do you combine organic content with paid promotion?
faqs.answer: Yes. Good social media work usually needs both sides working together: organic content to build trust and paid promotion to reach people faster. faqs.question: How do you plan a social media strategy before posting?

faqs.question: What do your SEO services in India include?
faqs.answer: Our SEO services in India start with a full SEO audit, then cover on page SEO like titles and content structure, and off page SEO like backlinks and mentions. We also handle Shopify SEO for ecommerce stores, local SEO for city based brands, and general SEO for D2C brands growing across India.

faqs.question: How do you start an SEO project?
faqs.answer: We run a full SEO audit before touching anything on your site. It shows what is actually wrong, whether that is weak content, slow load times, broken canonical tags, or pages that search engines cannot read well. Then we fix both the on page and off page sides together.

faqs.question: Do you promise SEO rankings overnight?
faqs.answer: No. Search engines do not work that way, and we never promise overnight results. We keep reporting simple and honest, and we care more about whether your traffic actually buys something than about a report full of rankings. SEO builds over time as trust builds with Google.

faqs.question: Do you offer Shopify SEO and local SEO?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle Shopify SEO for ecommerce stores, local SEO for brands serving specific cities like Jaipur, and general SEO for D2C brands trying to grow across India. The plan always starts with what your actual customers search for before they buy, not random keywords.

faqs.question: What is AEO and do you include it?
faqs.answer: AEO means answer engine optimization. More people now ask questions through AI tools and voice assistants, so we structure your content to help your brand show up there too, not just on a regular Google search page. We include it alongside traditional SEO work.

faqs.question: Have you achieved SEO results for a real brand?
faqs.answer: Yes. For a wellness brand we worked with, organic growth became a real part of their revenue. You can read the full story in our Jalvayu Wellness case study, which shows how SEO worked together with branding and marketing instead of running as a separate task.

faqs.question: What does your D2C branding and growth service include?
faqs.answer: We work on brand positioning, visual identity, and messaging so your D2C business feels like one connected experience, from product pages to packaging to retention emails. We also write website copy, product pages, and landing pages, and look at your acquisition channels to find the right mix.

faqs.question: Why does a D2C brand need more than a good product?
faqs.answer: A good product is not enough anymore. Many D2C brands launch with something solid, but the website confuses people, the brand voice keeps changing, and customers do not stick around. If things do not say the same thing everywhere, that gap quietly costs you sales.

faqs.question: Are you a branding agency in India that also handles marketing?
faqs.answer: Yes. As a branding agency in India, we connect branding with performance marketing and social media marketing, so every part of your D2C business grows in the same direction. Branding does not sit alone as a design task, it supports ads, content, and your website.

faqs.question: What results have your D2C clients seen?
faqs.answer: A wellness brand we worked with grew its monthly revenue five times in six months once branding and marketing worked together. A street food brand, Urban Vada Pav, grew daily footfall from 40 to 210. Both are covered in detail in our case studies.

faqs.question: Do you help with customer retention after the first sale?
faqs.answer: Yes. Combined with retention programmes like email and SMS, our branding and website work helps turn one time buyers into repeat customers instead of losing them after the first sale. Consistent messaging across ads, site, and emails makes people far more likely to come back.

faqs.answer: Our conversion rate optimization services start with a full audit of your product pages, checkout flow, and overall site experience to find exactly where visitors drop off. We then fix those moments and test changes through A/B testing, rather than assuming what will work.

faqs.question: How do you decide what to fix on my website?
faqs.answer: We look at real user behaviour: how people scroll, where they click, and where they stop. Sometimes the problem is a confusing call to action, sometimes a slow page, and sometimes too much friction before checkout. The data decides what we change first.

faqs.question: What conversion improvements have you delivered?

faqs.question: Why optimize conversions before spending more on ads?
faqs.answer: The traffic you already have is traffic you already paid for. Improving how much of it converts is one of the most direct ways to grow without raising your ad budget, which means more purchases, fewer drop offs, and a lower cost per customer over time.

faqs.question: Is conversion rate optimization in digital marketing separate from SEO and ads?
faqs.answer: No. It works best alongside SEO and paid campaigns, since better pages help every channel perform better. We connect it with our performance marketing and web development services, because a well built page and a well run campaign need to work together to convert.

faqs.question: What is a video script and why does it matter?
faqs.answer: A script is the written plan for a video: what gets said, in what order, and how it flows from start to finish. It is the base every good video is built on, because a weak script means confused viewers, low watch time, and ads skipped early.

faqs.question: How do you write a script for a YouTube video?
faqs.answer: We start with the main point you want to get across, build an opening that hooks the viewer in the first few seconds, then structure the middle and end so the video flows naturally instead of feeling scattered. Full YouTube and explainer scripts are part of our service.

faqs.question: Do you write short video scripts for reels and shorts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most of our scripting work is for short form content like reels, shorts, and quick social videos, since that is where most brands need consistent, fast turnaround content. We also create hooks and openings written to stop the scroll.

faqs.question: Can your scripts be used with text to video tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We write scripts specifically so they work well when turned into video using text to video generation, keeping sentences clear and paced right for on screen delivery, which helps when you produce videos without a full shoot. This makes the later video production step faster and smoother.

faqs.question: Do you help with content planning, not only scripts?
faqs.answer: Yes. We help plan what content to create in the first place, so scripts are not written in isolation but fit into a proper content calendar and brand message. That means more ideas ready to shoot without last minute scrambling.

faqs.question: Will a better script improve my results?
faqs.answer: Yes. A clear script means people watch longer, understand the message faster, and are more likely to act on it, which directly helps both organic reach and ad performance. Scripts can also be written in multiple variations for testing. Better scripts also make content production faster, with less back and forth.

faqs.question: What does your video editing service include?
faqs.answer: It covers cutting and trimming footage, adding transitions, captions, sound design, and basic colour correction, turning raw clips into a finished, publish ready video. faqs.question: Do you edit for platforms like TikTok and Instagram?

faqs.question: How is a video editing agency different from a freelance editor?

faqs.question: Can you edit multiple versions of a video for testing?

faqs.question: Do I need a script, or can you work with raw footage?

faqs.question: Will better video editing improve performance?

faqs.question: What is AI video editing?
faqs.answer: AI video editing means using AI tools to handle certain parts of editing on their own, like trimming pauses, syncing captions, or spotting highlight moments, instead of doing every step by hand. It speeds up the repetitive groundwork so more videos can go out in the same time.

faqs.question: Does AI edited content look robotic?
faqs.answer: No. Done properly and reviewed afterward, it looks completely normal. AI takes care of the repetitive groundwork, but the final feel of the video still comes from an actual editor, who adds a manual review and polish on top of every AI edit.

faqs.question: Do you check videos manually after AI editing?

faqs.question: Does AI editing work for long YouTube videos?

faqs.question: What does podcast editing involve?

faqs.question: Can you edit both audio and video podcasts?

faqs.question: Can you turn my podcast into short clips for social media?

faqs.question: How long does podcast editing take?

faqs.question: Can you help if I am just starting a podcast?

faqs.question: Will better editing help my podcast grow?

faqs.question: What are motion graphics?
faqs.answer: Motion graphics are animated visuals, text, icons, shapes, or graphics that move. They are used to explain something, highlight a point, or make a piece of content more interesting to watch, and they are built digitally rather than filmed with a camera.

faqs.question: Can motion graphics be added to videos I already have?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is common. We often add animated captions, transitions, or callouts into footage that is already edited, to strengthen a specific part of the video. This works alongside our video editing service without needing to reshoot anything. It is a simple way to lift existing content.

faqs.question: What kinds of motion graphics do you create?
faqs.answer: The range runs from simple text and icon animation to detailed explainer style graphics and logo animation, plus short brand intros. We choose the style based on what actually suits your content, not on what happens to be trending that month.

faqs.question: Do motion graphics help with social media ads?
faqs.answer: Yes. Movement naturally catches attention faster than a still image, so motion graphics tend to help ads stop the scroll more effectively. Every bit of movement supports what you are trying to say, rather than just making the ad look busy.

faqs.question: Will the animation match my brand?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build the animation style around your brand colours, fonts, and general tone, so it feels like it belongs to your brand rather than being bolted on. We keep one consistent visual style running across everything we animate for you.

faqs.question: Do you use Adobe After Effects?
faqs.answer: Mostly, yes. Adobe After Effects gives us the flexibility to build something custom around your brand instead of relying on generic, pre made templates. This applies to both short clips and longer videos, including full animated explainers. The result is animation shaped around your message, not a recycled look.
